body:
Merged origin/main into issue/1708-straight-gap-link. This resolves the conflict in crates/app/src/operation/params.rs.

Resolution: kept main's superset trochoidal digest for the Adaptive2D arm. It uses the 0xA5 method marker and the 0xA6 trochoidal-parameter block (max_engagement, ret, return_feed, loop_width) in digest-format-valid order.

The branch's gap_link 0x4D digest was carried into mill3d.rs's Finish3D arm, because main delegates Finish3D to stamp_mill3d. The gap_link field was added to the Finish3D test initializer in setup_align_3d.rs.

Targeted gate results:
- cargo check -p camcraft-app: clean
- cargo check -p camcraft-app --tests: clean
- cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings: clean
- cargo test -p camcraft-app --test adaptive_trochoid: 12 passed
- cargo xtask gate quick: timed out after 15 minutes building test binaries; no failure attributed to this change

Pushed to fork/issue/1708-straight-gap-link (commit 004e43cfe).
Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).

I cannot set labels. A collaborator must clear the conflicts label.

Back to draft. The merge of main brought two new motion suites and one new app suite. Their parameter initializers had no gap_link field, so the merged branch did not build them. Three new commits add gap_link: GapLink::Jump to those suites. Jump is every pre-gap-link file: these tests pin other behaviour, not the link choice. No production code changed. I will gate the new head and flag the PR ready again.

Ready for a re-check on head 6df0afea6.

**What changed since 004e43cfe**

1. Merged `origin/main` (merge commit c6949a1af). The merge was clean.
2. `test(motion): pin the straight link at the holes, not at the rim row` (dc38d2869).
3. `test(motion): give the new hole and chord suites the Jump gap link` (d8b53d05b).
4. `test(app): give the wcs_start suite the Jump gap link` (75c649c35).
5. `fix(ui): keep operation-page controls clear of the scroll bar` (f03b37120).
6. `test(ui): give the guide-project fixtures the gap link field` (6df0afea6).

**Why the pin moved (dc38d2869)**

The review finding was correct that the old pin failed. The cause is not a
bug in the straight link. The PR's own `pieces.reverse()` fix in `raster.rs`
pairs the rim-row pieces correctly now. On that rim row (y ≈ -1.495), the
march rests the ball about 0.005 mm into the outer flank, inside exact
tangency. The exact sweep verdict then refuses the direct link, as the "ver
certified or not at all" law requires. The z = 12.0 hop over the rim stays.
That is the safe answer: an uncertified line is never posted.

So the pin now proves what the feature actually delivers:
- `straight_links_holes_at_the_run_height` now asserts that no rapid at the
  retract height crosses a hole centre line. The straight links do this at
  the run height.
- `jump_mode_still_hops_over_the_holes` is the negative control. With
  `GapLink::Jump` the old retract-height hops are still there, so the test
  proves the straight mode changed the output, not the fixture.

**Build fixes (d8b53d05b, 75c649c35, 6df0afea6)**

Main gained three suites after this branch: `finish3d_holes`,
`finish3d_overhang_and_chord`, `wcs_start`. Their parameter initializers had
no `gap_link` field. The merged branch did not build them. Each now sets
`gap_link: GapLink::Jump`. Jump reproduces every pre-gap-link file exactly,
and none of the three suites tests link choice. The same fix went to the
guide-project fixtures in 6df0afea6. No production code changed in these
commits.

**The scroll-bar fix (f03b37120)**

The ramp checkbox in the Passes tab did not answer clicks. egui draws a
ScrollArea's vertical bar over the right edge of the viewport. The property
rows put their control at the right edge, so the checkbox sat in the bar's
hit zone and the bar took the click. The Passes tab of the 3D mills grew
past the viewport, so only that control looked broken. The fix stops the
scroll content 10 px short of the edge, so no control sits under the bar.
A real mouse and the kittest click both land now.

**Gate**

`cargo xtask gate quick` on 75c649c35: 41 steps, all green.
For the two later commits:
- `camcraft-ui` lib tests: 1170 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui`: clean.

**Not exercised**

The rim-row straight link itself. The verdict refuses it by design. A
looser budget would let it post; we kept the strict law.
